title: "M0-07: Transient and permanent failures"
format: html

**Feature ID:** `decide-transient-and-permanent-failures`.

**Owner:** `pipsystem` design record. `stamp` selects rebuild work; logging
records events and does not decide.

**Git author:** R. Andres Castaneda. **Original recorder:** UNKNOWN.

## Decision

In incremental mode, skip successful unchanged work. An unchanged deterministic
failure waits for analyst review and an input or rule change. An external service
failure is eligible on the next analyst-started execution. This avoids repeating
deterministic failures without treating an external outage as permanent. There
are no automatic runs or retry loops.

**Inputs:** Input or rule changes and recorded outcomes, including the distinction
between deterministic and external service failures.

**Outputs:** Work eligibility for the next analyst-started execution. The
separately approved end-of-run `data.table` reports attempted outcomes, failures,
and blocked work with a short summary; persistent run records stay separate.
